conventions.analog: 4 of SC+'s 6 components (avg EV / HardHit% / Barrel%/BBE / SwingMiss%) z-blended at 100+10z within the AAA pool, from Savant minors statcast-search aggregates — Z-Contact/Chase splits have no historical source (documented gap)
conventions.cohort: debut year Y with qualifying AAA Savant aggregate in Y-1 (min 100 PA, AAA-pool-restricted)
conventions.outcomes: first-MLB-season OPS (>= 100 PA) / ERA (>= 100 BF, inverted); first-2y bWAR (2026 debuts excluded — window open)
conventions.live_trail: per-season statcast_metrics/zone_metrics rows began accumulating 2026 — the literal composite becomes forward-scoreable as those cohorts debut

verdict.summary: WEAK forward signal, published per the audit's publish-the-r rule: final-AAA contact analog vs first-MLB rate outcomes r ~ 0.12-0.17; vs 2y bWAR ~ 0 (hitters). Consistent with the known ISO+ -> MLB ISO r=0.24 prior. SC+ remains descriptive — downstream consumers (breakout gate, ETA modifier, spotlight boost) should treat it as a tiebreaker, never a driver; the ETA backtest scores the core heuristic WITHOUT the SC+ nudge.
